descriptionHtml:
The advanced PCB design workshop is an activity that is organized by the IEEE student branch of the University of Peradeniya in collaboration with the Open University of Sri Lanka. 

This consists of three online workshop sessions and project submission at the end. The first two webinars will be conducted by Mr. Ranjan Kulathunga on PCB Designing from Basics & Review of PCBs Advanced tips. The third will be conducted by Prof. Aruna Gunawardena on Applications of PCBs and PCB Fabrication. 

The main purpose of these webinars is to give participants a chance to learn PCB designing from a basic level to an advanced level. Participants can form a group of a maximum of three members and they can submit the final task at the end of the webinar sessions. Three winning teams will be awarded.
